allowed_root.description: Optional single allowed commitment-tree root (stub window).

mock_verify.description: When true, proof verify is mocked (lab / ict film). Production: false + zk-api.

zkid.description: Circuit id registered in x/wasm for `proof_instance_verify`. Optional until circuit lands.

definitions.name: cosmwasm_std_binary_Binary
definitions.description:
Binary is a wrapper around Vec<u8> to add base64 de/serialization
with serde. It also adds some helper methods to help encode inline.

This is only needed as serde-json-{core,wasm} has a horrible encoding for Vec<u8>.
See also <https://github.com/CosmWasm/cosmwasm/blob/main/docs/MESSAGE_TYPES.md>.

create_pool.description: Create a virtual pool (factory-lite; multi-pool map like pair registry).

set_allowed_root.description: Stub root window for membership narrative.

set_pool_status.description: Pause / unpause — mirrors `crates/dex` pair `PoolPaused` window spirit.

settle_swap.description:
Settle a private swap: verify proof → host recompute → nullifiers + reserves.

Transparent analog: `crates/dex` `ExecuteMsg::Swap { offer_asset, max_spread, ... }`
but offer is a **proven note spend**, not a bank push.

definitions.name: cw_private_dex_msg_Pool
definitions.description:
Virtual pool — public reserves only (private notes stay off transparent balances).

Parallel to astroport `PairInfo` + reserve balances, but assets are 32-byte
domain ids and reserves are virtual (not queried from bank).
